full_details: Callers stop at the foot of the stair, and Mistress Ansell stood on the second step to make sure of it. Heminges brought a custard from his wife in a cloth, and a question. The king is billed for tomorrow. The Inns have written it down. Gaunt has a face like a loaf. You came down in a nightcap. Pope will do it. He has nothing till the garden in the third act. You said he will die at Ely House and rise a gardener. Heminges said he will get a laugh on this England. You said he will not. Mistress Pope says he was near weeping at the roll last night. She was not in the room, and the roll was not in the room. Garnish has cut the long cue. You did not take a length for it. The Rose has something of a woman and a wonder. You said to let them. You have a king and a custard. She said you were to have the custard and no more talk. After he went, you wrote four words. Pope has Thursday. You do not. You do not know how the king will go.
one_sentence: Heminges stopped at the foot of the stair with a custard, and you gave Gaunt to Pope for tomorrow.
title: A custard, and Gaunt given to Pope
